description: This file defines the EntryCollection class within the OrangeHRM LDAP DTO namespace. It manages a collection of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects and provides functionality to count total entries and retrieve the collection array.

classes.name: EntryCollection
classes.description: A class representing a collection of LDAP entry lookup setting pairs, with methods for counting entries and retrieving the collection array.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection with an array of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of entries across all lookup setting pairs, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: getCollections
methods.description: Returns the array of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.
